title: Antidote
subtitle: D-Don't worry! Sotheby's got everything in her mansion! You'll definitely get better!

items.text: Antidote

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: How long before we get to the manor? Miss Sotheby, we've been driving for more than 40 minutes.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Soon around the corner ahead and we're out, then ... huh!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hah? What's that shadow? It's moving! And there's water on it ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Waffle, that's the Manus Vindictae's believer! Get around now, don't let them see us!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: No! We can't turn around now.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: No! They found us!

items.speaker: The Manus Believer
items.text: *roars*

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Let's fight. Put an end to all that's happening in this ridiculous forest.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We must not let the Manus know where we are going.

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: Copy. Let's make it fast!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: There should be no other enemies. Are you alright? Is anybody hurt?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Uggh ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Are you okay, Mr. APPLe?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: I got accidentally splashed by their slime. It must contain a high concentration of toxins ... *cough*

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Whoa ... you are going mouldy!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: You need the antidote made from leeches, glass lizard blood, black fern root and at least two phoenix heart nerves!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: They are very hard to find, but fortunately, I have them all!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Thank you. But this APPLe might need a little bit of ... Mancozeb.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: "Mango Cub"? What's that?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Ahh ... ahem ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Huh! Mr. APPLe passed out!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Don't worry, don't worry! I've got all kinds of potion materials at my house. I'll get them when we're back!
Manor hall

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: After the "auto island" passing through ten different gardens, they finally get to the gate of the manor.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Phew! Finally got home!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hmm? That's weird. Where is everybody? Anyone there! Someone needs an antidote!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Is that ... a unicorn on the wall?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Ah, it turned around ... I thought it was a statue, but it is still alive?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: It's not a statue. It is the Quiet Ravenheart.

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: The sorcerer and heretic ... oh God, forgive me, Sweet Mary mother of Jesus ...

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Ahhh! What has flown over! God bless us!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh, don't be afraid! Hahaha ... that's my dearest Sasana! You are here to welcome me!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Sasana? Well, this is the first time I have seen so many arcane creatures and plants for real ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Heh heh, it's a mini Schnellgeiste. My father found it near the Blue Ridge Mountains in Braddock Heights.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Don't worry. It no longer sucks human blood. It's my good friend now, and will welcome me home every time!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Speaking of which ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: It's so weird. Where are all the servants at the door today? Mr. Karson would never allow this ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Mr. Karson! Sotheby is back!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Mr. Karson?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: It seems there's no one else but us here.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Well, it's really weird. Forget it. Leave Mr. Karson alone. I have to find the "Mango Carrot" quickly!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: I will be back soon! Hold on in there, Mr. APPLe!

items.speaker: Special Action Team Captain
items.text: Hmm ... what Mr. APPLe just mentioned, is it really "Mango Carrot"?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I am so sorry. I did not hear it clearly either.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I made a small cut of his leaf to release venom. Hopefully the toxin will take effect slower ...

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: Umm ...

items.speaker: Marian
items.text: I think what he said was "Mancozeb," an organometallic fungicide humans apply on plants.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ma ... Mea ... Mon ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Huh! Not in the index starting with "M". So, Co ... Coe ... Cost ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Nothing! How could it be possible?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: We ... we should have all the potion materials in our warehouse. Is that ... in Latin?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What can I do ... huh! I promised to cure Mr. APPLe ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Clang.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Umm?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Did I hear something?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Clang. Clang.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Someone is here! What happened? This floor is a private storage area. Servants are strictly forbidden ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: And I never met any servant along the way ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Phew ... around this corner ... I'm just gonna sneak a peek, making no sound ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: M-Mr. Karson?!

items.speaker: Mr. Karson
items.text: Miss Sotheby, you're back.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: You ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Why are you standing in front of our No. 18 vault?
TO BE CONTINUED…
